fa808856120f2ebb.text: Does the customer ask to exchange an item for a different size, color, or version?

criteria.true_description: The customer explicitly requests replacing an ordered item with an alternate variant, such as a different size, color, or model.
criteria.false_description: The customer seeks an identical replacement for defects, a standard return or refund, or asks about availability without requesting a swap.

d57963dd7735b181.text: Does the customer mention more than one order or an additional order?

criteria.true_description: The customer explicitly references two or more distinct order IDs, separate transactions, or introduces a second purchase alongside the primary one.
criteria.false_description: The customer refers to only one transaction, even with multiple items, split shipments, exchange replacements, or general questions about ordering policies.

e61a09b871e5fb39.text: Does the ticket refer to an order as being pending, just placed, or not yet shipped?

criteria.true_description: The ticket describes an existing order as currently processing, recently placed, awaiting fulfillment, or not yet handed over to a carrier.
criteria.false_description: The order is already dispatched, in transit

c266b85a7582c585.text: Does the ticket state or imply that the customer has already received an item or order?

criteria.true_description: The customer indicates physical possession by evaluating, using, unboxing, or seeking returns or repairs for goods they actually took in hand.
criteria.false_description: The shipment is pending, delayed, canceled pre-delivery, or marked delivered by tracking yet explicitly claimed missing by the customer.

4890e0593ae87c3c.text: Does the user ask to make changes or modifications to an order or its payment?

criteria.true_description: The user requests altering items, quantities, shipping address, delivery speed, or billing details for an existing, unfulfilled order.
criteria.false_description: The user requests complete cancellation, post-delivery returns or exchanges, updates account-level profile defaults, or solely checks order or payment status.

eb1b29d41a2bc99e.text: Does the ticket mention a specific city or geographic location?

criteria.true_description: The text contains a proper noun identifying a city, town, state, country, or distinct geographic landmark.
criteria.false_description: The text only includes generic terms like "local store," numerical store IDs, street addresses without a town, or carrier shipping statuses.

95a2164396546593.text: Does the text state that the customer wants to return one or more items?

criteria.true_description: The customer explicitly requests or declares an intent to send back received merchandise for a refund or store credit.
criteria.false_description: The customer requests an exchange, cancels an unfulfilled order, asks about policies hypothetically, or demands a refund without returning the item.
